# HubSpot renewal and cancellation guide (as of 2026-11-17)

## Default renewal behaviour
- **Subscriptions auto-renew unless you switch it off.** HubSpot's current Customer Terms of Service say that 
if you don't turn off the auto-renewal setting in Account & Billing, your Subscription will renew automatically.
 HubSpot's knowledge base says the same: 
keeping auto-renewal on renews the same subscription, term and billing cycle.

- **You can't cancel mid-term.** 
Except as the Agreement specifically provides, you may not cancel before the end of your Current Term. HubSpot won't refund prepaid or unused fees for the rest of that term.

- **Price increases at renewal are possible.** A February 2025 copy of the terms says 
HubSpot may raise fees up to its then-current list price. It says it will notify you at least 30 days before renewal if this applies.
 I did not confirm that this wording is unchanged in the current live version.

## Notice window
- **The current terms give a deadline but no lead time.** The notice must be given 
"prior to the end of your Current Term"
, and it applies unless your Agreement or Order says otherwise. HubSpot's renewal help page likewise says you must disable auto-renewal 
before your next Renewal Term.

- **No fixed number of days is stated in the sources I retrieved.** The pages I found don't give a fixed lead time, such as 30 or 60 days, for the standard terms. Treat any specific day count as **not verified. Confirm in your signed contract or with the vendor.**
- **Older terms were different.** Archived 2015 terms required 
notice no more than 90 days and no less than 45 days before the end of the Subscription Term.
 That is historical only. Contracts signed under older terms may still carry different notice periods.
- **Product-specific terms may add detail.** Older versions of the terms say 
the deadline varies by HubSpot product and edition, and point to the Product Specific Terms.
 I did not retrieve the current Product Specific Terms. Whether your Hub or edition has its own window is **not verified**.

## Steps to give notice (self-serve)
Per HubSpot's knowledge base:
1. 
Click your account name (top right), then Account & Billing.

2. 
Open the Subscriptions tab.

3. 
In the Auto-Renewal Terms section, click Cancel auto-renewal.

4. 
Select the products to cancel. To cancel everything, select all products.

5. 
Review the cancellation details, then click Cancel auto-renewal.


Notes on this process:
- **Who can do it:** 
Super Admins or users with billing admin permissions.
 
If you don't see the button, check your billing admin permissions or contact HubSpot Support.
